chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Straightening out the chronology: Peanuts in Denver and two years off
summary: He clarifies the order: Tropicana, Peanuts's Denver club, two years living in Vegas until Eve got sick, then time off.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: This is after I got back playing pain from the ear operation.
Yeah, you're putting the cart before the horse, there, because I'd been with George and I used to stop and work with Peanuts in Denver, he had a club there, with Davi McKenna and Morry Feld.
I enjoyed that. And I think that was a period of adjustment, to the sound, the noise of the room. And everything, I got used to --
-- so -- so then Eve and I went up -- we stayed up there. We had an apartment up there --
-- but we lived up there for about two years. Until she got sick and then that was it, then that's when I took two years off.
You see how it falls in?
Then I went back up to see my son who was living up there, and that's when I went to work at Caesar's Palace.
This was your oldest son was living there? This was your oldest son?
Who's now gone out to the West Coast. Who's now with (unintelligible).
I mean -- I meant L. A. From -- from -- from Vegas, yeah.
